coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 外壳不动；内部望远镜使用水平转台和俯仰轴两个关节。

states.name: 收泊·灯灭
states.visual_description: Same glass dome stays completely fixed. Interior telescope yaw 0 degrees, elevation 10 degrees, all lamps off.

states.name: 低空观测
states.visual_description: Interior telescope yaw 30 degrees, elevation 25 degrees on its gimbal, warm dome-base ring light. Glass shell fixed.

states.name: 高空观测
states.visual_description: Telescope yaw 60 degrees, elevation 55 degrees, pale cyan dome-base ring and windows. Fixed dome with same ribs.

states.name: 回转扫描
states.visual_description: Telescope yaw minus 25 degrees, elevation 35 degrees, soft lavender ring. Dome never opens or changes shape.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。
